Setting.Name: Mode
Setting.Summary: Auto, Setup, Questing, CookingFishing, Archaeology, or PrimaryProfessions.

Setting.Name: Enable Fishing and Cooking
Setting.Summary: Allow Auto mode to load Cooking/Fishing when not maxed.

Setting.Name: Enable Archaeology at 20+
Setting.Summary: Allow Auto mode to switch to ArchaeologyBuddy at level 20+.

Setting.Name: Primary Profession 1
Setting.Summary: Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Enchanting, Engineering, Herbalism, Inscription, Jewelcrafting, Leatherworking, Mining, Skinning, Tailoring, or None.

Setting.Name: Prompt Profession Choice
Setting.Summary: At level 5+, prompt when fewer than 2 primary professions are known and choices are unset.

Setting.Name: Questing Profile Override
Setting.Summary: Optional HB profile path (absolute or relative to this file). Empty = automatic level/faction Kick profile.

Custom.Code: Log(Colors.DeepSkyBlue,"Ultimate 1-90:", Colors.LightGreen, "{0} | Lv{1} {2} {3} | {4} | Mode={5}", Me.Name, Me.Level, Me.Race, Me.Class, (Me.IsAlliance ? "Alliance" : Me.IsHorde ? "Horde" : "Neutral/undecided"), AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetData("ULT_MODE"));

If.Condition: !(bool)AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetData("ULT_HANDLED") && ((string)AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetData("ULT_MODE") == "cookingfishing" || ((string)AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetData("ULT_MODE") == "auto" && (bool)Settings["Enable Fishing and Cooking"] && Me.Level >= 5 && (Fishing.MaxLevel == 0 || Cooking.MaxLevel == 0 || Fishing.Level < Fishing.MaxLevel || Cooking.Level < Cooking.MaxLevel)))

Custom.Code: AppDomain.CurrentDomain.SetData("ULT_HANDLED", true); Log(Colors.DeepSkyBlue,"Ultimate 1-90:", Colors.LightGreen, "Cooking/Fishing handoff (faction JWheels PB profile).");
Log(Colors.Orange,"Ultimate 1-90:", Colors.Yellow, "Faction not chosen yet; load an Alliance/Horde Cooking-Fishing profile manually after choosing a faction.");

AppDomain.CurrentDomain.SetData("ULT_HANDLED", true); Log(Colors.DeepSkyBlue,"Ultimate 1-90:", Colors.LightGreen, "Archaeology handoff (level 20+). ArchaeologyBuddy settings: AutoTrain / TrainUpto control training and skill cap.");
AppDomain.CurrentDomain.SetData("ULT_HANDLED", true); Log(Colors.Orange,"Ultimate 1-90:", Colors.Yellow, "Archaeology is level-gated to 20+ in this controller; no bot switch was made.");

LoadProfile.Path: ..\..\1-90 Questing Profile Pack\Professions\Skinning\[A - Fly] QO Skinning 1-525 [Kick].xml

Custom.Code: Log(Colors.Orange,"Ultimate 1-90:", Colors.Yellow, "Only an Alliance Skinning leveling profile is bundled; load a Horde skinning profile manually.");

Log(Colors.Orange,"Ultimate 1-90:", Colors.Yellow, "Blacksmithing/Engineering/Leatherworking have no complete leveling profile bundled. Train manually and provide a profile; gathering/crafting choices with mappings can still be loaded.");
Log(Colors.Orange,"Ultimate 1-90:", Colors.Yellow, "No primary professions selected. Run Setup or set Primary Profession 1/2 in PB Settings.");
Log(Colors.DeepSkyBlue,"Ultimate 1-90:", Colors.White, "Controller pass complete (Setup, level 90, or no enabled action). Set Mode and re-run to continue another activity.");
